Graphical Posterior Predictive Checks for DOAS Bayesian Models

Source: R/ppc.R
pp_check.Rd

Leverages the bayesplot package to produce graphical posterior predictive checks (PPC) for doas Bayesian models. Compares observed survey counts \(y\) against replicated datasets \(y_{\text{rep}}\) generated by posterior_predict.

Usage

pp_check(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'doas'
pp_check(
  object,
  type = c("dens_overlay", "stat", "stat_2d", "bars", "intervals", "ribbon", "rootogram"),
  n_draws = 50,
  stat = "mean",
  target = c("count", "both", "obs1", "obs2"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A doas model object fitted with method = "Bayes".

...

Additional arguments passed to the underlying bayesplot::ppc_* function.

type

Character string specifying the plot type:

  • "dens_overlay": Density overlay of observed data and multiple \(y_{\text{rep}}\) draws.

  • "stat": Distribution of a test statistic across \(y_{\text{rep}}\) with the observed statistic marked.

  • "stat_2d": Joint scatterplot of two test statistics across \(y_{\text{rep}}\).

  • "bars": Bar plot comparing observed vs simulated count frequencies (ideal for zero-inflation).

  • "intervals": Medians and central posterior predictive intervals by sector.

  • "ribbon": Ribbon plot of predictive intervals across sectors.

  • "rootogram": Hanging rootogram comparing observed vs predicted counts.

n_draws

Number of posterior predictive draws to display (for types like "dens_overlay"). Default 50.

stat

Character string or function for the test statistic when type = "stat". Default "mean". Common choices: "mean", "sd", "max", "min", or custom function.

target

Character string specifying the observation target: "count" (default), "both", "obs1", "obs2".

Value

A ggplot object produced by bayesplot.
